tools.guide_html:
Panduan Lengkap

Mode 1: Gambar → Base64 (Encoding)

Konversi gambar apa pun ke URL data Base64 untuk disematkan langsung di kode.

Switch between Encode and Decode modes using the tabs at the top
  • Upload an image (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP)
  • Click "Encode to Base64"
  • The full data URL appears in the text area (format: data:image/png;base64,...)
  • Click "Copy" to copy to clipboard, or "Download as .txt" to save
When to use: Embed small icons directly in HTML/CSS to eliminate HTTP requests. Great for email signatures, single-file demos, and CSS background images.

Mode 2: Base64 → Gambar (Decoding)

Konversi string Base64 kembali ke gambar yang dapat dilihat dan diunduh.

  • Switch to the "Base64 → Image" tab
  • Paste a Base64 string or full data URL into the text area
  • Click "Decode to Image"
  • The decoded image appears below — click "Download Image" to save
Note: If you paste a raw Base64 string without the data:image/... prefix, the tool will auto-detect and add the appropriate header.

Kasus Penggunaan Terbaik

  • Inline HTML images — Embed small icons and logos directly in HTML without external files
  • CSS backgrounds — Use Base64 in background-image: url() for self-contained stylesheets
  • Email signatures — Ensure images display correctly in email clients
  • Single-file demos — Create standalone HTML files with embedded images
  • API testing — Inspect and decode Base64 image data from API responses

Tips Profesional

  • Base64 increases file size by approximately 33% — only use it for small images (<50KB ideally)
  • Data URLs work in all modern browsers and most email clients
  • For CSS, use background-image: url('data:image/png;base64,...')
  • For HTML, use <img src="data:image/png;base64,...">
  • Very large images (>2MB) will produce extremely long strings that may slow down page rendering

How to Use the Bulk Image Processor

Batch process dozens of images in under a minute. Here's how:

1

Drop or Select Images

Drag and drop multiple image files, or click the upload area to browse. You can select as many files as you need.

Pick a quick preset (Web Optimized, Print Ready, E-Commerce, Thumbnail) or expand "Processing Options" for full control over resize, format, quality, and watermark.

Configure Batch Rename

Toggle "Rename output files" to set a naming pattern with prefix and auto-numbering (e.g. product_001.jpg).

tools.guide_html:
Panduan Lengkap

Batch Resize

Masukkan lebar dan/atau tinggi target di bagian Ubah Ukuran. Dengan "Pertahankan rasio aspek" dicentang (default), alat secara otomatisly scales the other dimension. Leave both empty to keep original dimensions. This is perfect for normalizing product photos or creating uniform social media assets.

Tips: Jika Anda hanya memasukkan lebar, tinggi secara otomatis menyesuaikan untuk mempertahankan proporsi — tidak perlu perhitungan.

Batch Compress & Convert

Gunakan dropdown Format Output untuk mengonversi semua gambar ke JPG, PNG, atau WebP. JPG adalah pilihan terbaik untuk fotos (small file size), PNG preserves transparency, and WebP offers modern compression. The Quality slider (10-100%) lets you balance file size versus visual quality — 80-85% is the sweet spot for web use.

Tips: WebP sering dapat mengurangi ukuran file hingga 25-35% dibandingkan dengan JPG pada level kualitas yang sama.

Batch Watermark

Masukkan teks watermark, sesuaikan ukuran font dan opasitas, lalu pilih posisi (kanan bawah, kiri bawah, kanan atas, kiri atast, or center). Leave the text field blank to skip watermarks. Great for branding batch photos before publishing.

Tips: Jaga opasitas antara 20-40% untuk watermark yang profesional dan tidak mengganggu.

Batch Rename

Aktifkan "Ganti nama file output" dan atur awalan serta nomor awal. File akan dinamai secara berurutan: awalan_001.ext, prefix_002.ext, etc. The numbering is zero-padded (3 digits by default).

Tips: Gunakan awalan deskriptif seperti produk_, galeri_, atau foto_ for easy file organization.

Using Presets

Klik tombol preset apa pun untuk langsung mengonfigurasi beberapa pengaturan sekaligus:

  • Web Optimized — 80% quality, max 1200px width. Ideal for blog images, portfolio thumbnails, and website assets.
  • Print Ready — 100% quality, max 3000px. Best for photo printing, high-res archiving, and professional deliverables.
  • E-Commerce — 85% quality, max 1000px. Optimized for product listings on marketplaces like Amazon, eBay, or Shopify.
  • Thumbnail — 60% quality, max 300px. Perfect for preview images, avatars, or gallery thumbnails.

Setelah menerapkan preset, Anda masih dapat menyempurnakan pengaturan individual di panel Opsi Pemrosesan.

Kasus Penggunaan Terbaik

  • Website asset preparation — batch resize and compress all product photos for your e-commerce site
  • Photo batch compression — reduce storage footprint of large photo collections
  • Social media content — standardize image sizes and formats for multiple platforms
  • Photography portfolio — add watermarks to protect your work while batch exporting
  • Digital asset management — batch rename and convert archive images for consistent naming

tools.guide_html:
Panduan Lengkap

📷 Step 1: Take a Good Portrait Photo

Kualitas foto ID akhir Anda sangat bergantung pada gambar sumber. Untuk hasil terbaik, ikuti tips berikut:

Berdiri di depan dinding polos berwarna terang (putih atau putih gading paling cocok). Pastikan wajah Anda berada di tengah bingkai dan kedua telinga terlihat. Gunakan even, soft lighting — natural window light from the front is ideal. Avoid harsh overhead lights that cast shadows under your eyes, nose, and chin. If wearing glasses, check that there is no glare on the lenses. Some countries require glasses to be removed entirely for ID photos.

Lepaskan penutup kepala seperti topi atau syal kecuali dikenakan karena alasan agama atau medis. Jaga ekspresi netral dengan mulut tertutup dan kedua eyes open, looking directly at the camera. Take the photo from straight on — your head should not be tilted or turned.

🌍 Step 2: Select Your Country and Photo Type

Telusuri daftar negara di bawah area unggah dan klik jenis foto yang Anda butuhkan. Setiap negara memiliki persyaratan ukuran spesifik yang diukur dalam milimeters (mm) or inches. The tool automatically crops your photo to the correct aspect ratio for the selected standard.

Standar paspor dan visa populer:

  • 🇺🇸 US Passport — 2 × 2 inches (51 × 51 mm), white background. Same size for US Visa, Green Card, and Driver License.
  • 🇬🇧 UK Passport — 35 × 45 mm, light gray background. UK Visa and BRP use 35 × 45 mm with white background.
  • 🇨🇳 China Passport — 33 × 48 mm, white background. China ID Card 26 × 32 mm (white or blue for 2nd Gen), Driver License 22 × 32 mm.
  • 🇪🇺 Schengen Visa — 35 × 45 mm, light background. Same size for Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and Netherlands passports.
  • 🇮🇳 India Passport — 35 × 50 mm, white background. Aadhaar is 35 × 35 mm square, PAN Card is 25 × 25 mm.
  • 🇨🇦 Canada Passport — 50 × 70 mm, white background (larger than most). Canada Visa is 35 × 45 mm.
  • 🇯🇵 Japan Passport — 35 × 45 mm, white background. Japan Visa uses the same dimensions.
  • 🇲🇽 Mexico Passport — 25 × 32 mm, white background (child-like proportion).
  • 🇧🇷 Brazil Passport — 35 × 45 mm, white background.
  • 🇦🇺 Australia Passport — 35 × 45 mm, white background.
  • 🇰🇷 South Korea Passport — 35 × 45 mm, white background.
  • 🇷🇺 Russia Passport — 35 × 45 mm, white background.
  • Custom Size — Enter any width and height manually if your country is not listed.

Jika jenis ID spesifik Anda tidak tercantum, gunakan opsi Ukuran Kustom di bagian bawah daftar negara dan masukkan dimensi yang tepat required by your application.

🎨 Step 3: Choose the Right Background Color

Dokumen ID yang berbeda memerlukan warna latar belakang yang berbeda. Alat kami memungkinkan Anda memilih dari lima warna preset atau memilih warna kustom:

  • White (#ffffff) — The most common background for passports and visas worldwide. Used by US, India, Canada, Japan, Australia, Schengen, Brazil, South Korea, Russia, and most other countries.
  • Blue (#3b82f6) — Required for Chinese 2nd generation ID cards (shenfenzheng) and Chinese residence permits. Also used for driver's licenses in many US states.
  • Red (#ef4444) — Used for some Chinese official documents, professional certificates, and certain visa photos.
  • Gray (#9ca3af) — Required specifically for UK passport photos. Light gray backgrounds are also accepted for some Schengen visa applications.
  • Green (#22c55e) — Occasionally used for specific official documents and professional applications in some jurisdictions.

Mesin penghapus latar belakang AI memproses foto Anda dan mengganti latar belakang asli dengan bersih. Hasilnya adalah latar belakang profesional, seragam, dan color that meets official requirements.

⬇️ Step 4: Generate and Download Your ID Photo

Setelah Anda mengunggah foto, memilih standar negara, dan memilih warna latar belakang, klik tombol "Hasilkan Foto ID"n. The tool will:

  1. Run AI background removal to extract the subject from the original background
  2. Composite the subject onto your chosen background color
  3. Crop the image to the exact aspect ratio of your selected country standard
  4. Render the final image at 300 DPI for high-quality printing

Pemrosesan biasanya memakan waktu 3-10 detik tergantung perangkat Anda. Model AI berjalan sepenuhnya di browser Anda — tidak ada yang diunggah ke server mana pun. Setelar processing, click "Download" to save the PNG file. You can then print it at any photo kiosk or load it into an online application.

📋 Photo Requirements Checklist

Sebelum mengambil foto ID Anda, periksa daftar ini untuk memastikan memenuhi standar resmi:

  • Front-facing with both eyes visible and open — no side profiles or closed eyes
  • Neutral expression with mouth closed — no smiling, frowning, or raised eyebrows
  • Plain white or off-white background — no patterns, textures, or objects behind you
  • Even lighting — no shadows on your face, behind your head, or on the background
  • Head centered and upright — not tilted, turned, or rotated in any direction
  • No hats or head coverings — except for religious, cultural, or medical reasons documented in advance
  • No glasses if possible — if required, ensure no glare, heavy frames blocking eyes, or tinted lenses
  • Recent photo — taken within the last 6 months for most passport and visa applications
  • High resolution — at least 600 × 600 pixels recommended; 1200 × 1200 or higher is ideal
  • Both ears visible — hair should be pulled back if it covers the ears
  • No other people or objects visible in the frame — only the applicant should appear
  • Properly exposed — not too dark (underexposed) or too bright (overexposed, blown-out highlights)

Klik "Hapus EXIF" untuk menghapus semua metadata tersembunyi dari gambar. Ini termasuk:

Langkah 2: Pilih Faktor Skala

Pilih seberapa besar Anda ingin memperbesar gambar:

  • 2x: Doubles the dimensions. A 800×600 image becomes 1600×1200. Best for most use cases — good balance of quality and file size.
  • 3x: Triples the dimensions. A 800×600 image becomes 2400×1800. Great for printing at larger sizes.
  • 4x: Quadruples the dimensions. A 800×600 image becomes 3200×2400. Best for wallpaper-sized outputs or large prints, but file sizes will be significantly larger.
Tip: Higher scale factors produce larger files. If you just need a moderate size increase, 2x is usually sufficient.

Langkah 3: Sesuaikan Ketajaman

Saat gambar diperbesar, gambar bisa terlihat sedikit lembut atau buram. Filter penajaman menambahkan kontras tepi untuk membuat detail menonjol. Gunakan slider untuk mengontrol kekuatannya:

  • 0%: No sharpening — smoothest result, good for watercolor-style images
  • 50%: Balanced — good for most photos (default)
  • 100%: Maximum sharpening — best for text, line art, or screenshots

Pratinjau diperbarui secara real-time sehingga Anda dapat menemukan titik optimal. Penajaman berlebihan dapat menimbulkan halo di sekitar tepi, jadi mulai rendah dan tingkatkan secara bertahap.

  • PNG format preserves sharp edges — use it for logos, icons, and screenshots
  • Use JPG format for photographs to keep file sizes manageable at higher scales
  • Very large upscales (4x on already large images) may take a few seconds to process

Pilih dari preset cetak umum:

  • A4 (210×297mm): International standard, most common worldwide
  • Letter (8.5×11"): US standard, common in North America
  • A5 (148×210mm): Half of A4, for booklets and small flyers
  • 4×6" (10×15cm): Standard photo print size
  • 5×7" (13×18cm): Larger photo print, common for frames
  • Business Card (3.5×2"): Standard US business card size

Langkah 3: Atur DPI (Titik per Inci)

DPI menentukan kualitas cetak:

  • 72 DPI: Screen resolution, not recommended for printing
  • 150 DPI: Acceptable for large-format prints viewed from far away
  • 300 DPI: Standard for high-quality photo prints (recommended)
  • 600 DPI: Professional-grade printing, very large file sizes

Aturan praktis: Untuk cetakan foto, selalu gunakan 300 DPI. Untuk spanduk besar yang dilihat dari jarak >3m, 150 DPI sudah cukup.

Kasus Penggunaan Terbaik

  • Photo prints: Use A4 or 4×6" at 300 DPI → JPG
  • Business cards: Use Business Card preset at 300 DPI → PNG
  • Posters/banners: Custom size at 150 DPI → PNG
  • Documents: Use Letter or A4 at 300 DPI → JPG
  • Art prints: Use A4/A5 at 600 DPI → PNG (maximum quality)

Tips Profesional

  • For photo prints at a lab, always export at 300 DPI in sRGB color space
  • A4 at 300 DPI = 2480×3508 pixels — make sure your source image is at least that large
  • If your source image is smaller than the target DPI size, the result will be upsampled (quality loss) — use our Image Upscaler first
  • For inkjet home printing, 300 DPI is more than enough — 150 DPI looks nearly identical
  • Save as JPG with quality 92-95 for prints; use PNG only if you need to preserve sharp text or line art

tools.guide_html:
Panduan Lengkap

Langkah 1: Unggah atau Tempel SVG

Anda dapat mengunggah file .svg dengan menyeretnya ke zona jatuh, atau beralih ke tab "Tempel Kode SVG" dan tempel markup SVG mentah. Ini berguna saat Anda memiliki kode SVG dari Figma, Sketch, Adobe Illustrator, atau SVG tulisan tangan.

Langkah 2: Pilih Format Output

Pilih format output yang sesuai dengan kebutuhan Anda:

  • PNG: Lossless compression, supports transparency. Best for UI assets, logos, and icons.
  • JPG: Smaller file size, no transparency. Best for photos and complex graphics with many colors.
  • WebP: Modern format with excellent compression. Best for web use.

Langkah 3: Atur Faktor Skala

Faktor skala mengontrol resolusi output:

  • 1x: Same pixel dimensions as the SVG width/height
  • 2x: Double resolution — perfect for retina displays (@2x assets)
  • 3x: Triple resolution — for high-DPI displays
  • 4x: Quadruple resolution — for print-quality output

Karena SVG adalah format vektor, memperbesar tidak menghasilkan kehilangan kualitas. SVG 100×100 pada skala 4x menghasilkan PNG 400×400 yang tajam.

Langkah 4: Unduh

  • UI/UX designers: Export SVG icons to PNG for Android/iOS app assets
  • Web developers: Convert inline SVG to static images for <img> tags or CSS background-image
  • Print designers: Convert SVG logos to high-res PNG (4x scale) for print materials
  • Presentations: Convert SVG charts/graphs to PNG for PowerPoint or Keynote
  • Social media: Convert SVG illustrations to PNG for Instagram/Facebook posts

Tips Profesional

  • For sharp @2x mobile app assets, set Scale Factor to 2x and output as PNG
  • If your SVG has transparency, use PNG format to preserve it
  • For smallest file size with good quality, use WebP format at 2x scale
  • SVG <text> elements may render differently across browsers — convert to PNG to lock in fonts
  • For print, use 4x scale + PNG for maximum quality
  • You can paste SVG code directly — great for quick one-off conversions without saving a file
